_comment: The hand-maintained layer of the registry. Everything else in data/robots.json
is generated: scripts/build_registry.py reads upstream metadata from
robot_descriptions.py, parses each URDF, and verifies every mesh on the CDN.
To add a robot: find its description key in robot_descriptions.py (see
`python3 scripts/build_registry.py --candidates` for the ones whose URDF and
meshes fully resolve), add an entry below with the gallery category you want
it filed under, then re-run the build. Optional per-robot keys: id, name,
maker, dof, notes, notes_zh, links{official,docs,paper}, and pose (joint
name -> position, used for card renders when the zero pose looks broken).
Pose joint names are validated against the URDF at build time.
`loops` states a closed kinematic loop, which URDF has no way to: `connect`
names the two links and the point on each of them that are really one point,
and `solve` names the joints the viewer is free to move so they stay one
point — the same thing MJCF writes as <equality><connect>. Minitaur's four
five-bar legs are the case that needs it. Link and joint names are validated
against the URDF at build time; `pose` supplies the starting guess, so it is
what picks which way round a loop with two solutions closes.
preview_frame{palm,fingers} names two axes of the model's own root frame,
as "+x" .. "-z", and the viewer turns them onto the same world axes for
every entry that has one: palm -> +X, fingers -> +Z. It exists because URDF
fixes no facing, so the hands arrive pointing six different ways and no two
cards can be compared. `palm` is the way a fingertip travels when the finger
flexes, `fingers` the direction the four fingers grow; on a gripper, the side
you see the jaws spread across and the direction they reach. On a humanoid or
arm, read `palm` as the direction the model should face and `fingers` as up.
The two must be
different axes — the build rejects the pair otherwise.
A robot that robot_descriptions.py does not ship (unitree_ros carries a dozen
such) replaces `description` with an `upstream` block naming the repository,
the commit to pin, the URDF path and the licence — everything the build would
otherwise have read from a description module. Such an entry must set `id`,
and should set `name`, `maker` and `upstream.tags` too, since nothing else
supplies them. `upstream.package` names the ROS package directory; leave it
as "" when the repository root is itself the package.
The build probes that neighbourhood for every `package://` root, which is
enough for almost every repository. When it is not — a package kept outside
it, a directory renamed without the `package://` lines following, a relative
mesh path written for a working directory other than the URDF's own —
`upstream.packages` maps a package name to its real repository-relative root
and `upstream.mesh_rewrite` is a list of {from, to} applied to the resolved
path. Both are the same keys a `mirror` block takes, and neither invents a
file: a rewritten path is probed like any other, and an entry whose meshes
do not resolve still fails the build.
A machine that upstream ships as several URDFs in one folder (the G1 has
twenty-two, one per `mode_machine` and hand combination) is one entry with a
`variants` list, not one entry per file: the gallery gives it a single card
and its detail page a version picker. Each variant names an `urdf` — plus an
optional `mjcf`, `notes`, `notes_zh` and `deprecated` — and takes its id and
its picker label from the file's own name. The first one listed is what the
card and the detail page open on, so `upstream.urdf` may be left out; every
variant is parsed and mesh-probed exactly like an entry's own file. A variant
may also carry its own `name`, `id` and `package`, for a machine whose
versions upstream keeps in one package each rather than one folder — TRON2
ships sixteen of them, every file named robot.urdf and every one naming the
same `bipedal_robot` package. `mesh_rewrite` on a variant is appended to the
entry's rules, for a version that has to substitute one mesh the CDN will not
serve, or whose files live in a different tree than the package:// lines still
name. A variant may pin its own `commit` when that file lives at a different
revision of the same repository: Deep Robotics high-res Collada is the case,
kept in Git LFS until it was dropped from HEAD, so the high-res version names
the last commit that still had those files.

robots.name: G1
robots.notes: Upstream ships twenty-two G1 descriptions in one folder and twenty-one of them are this robot: 23- and 29-DOF bodies, locked waists, three-finger and Inspire hands, Dex1-1 grippers. The version picker swaps between them — each one's mode_machine ID and hardware are in its own note. The twenty-second, g1_dual_arm, has no legs and is filed under dual arm. Pinned past the commit robot_descriptions.py carries, which predates the mode 18 and Dex1-1 files.
robots.notes_zh: 上游在同一个目录里提供 22 个 G1 描述文件，其中 21 个是这台机器：23/29 自由度本体、锁腰版本、三指手与 Inspire 手、Dex1-1 夹爪。用版本选择器切换——每个版本的 mode_machine 号与硬件差异写在它自己的说明里。第 22 个 g1_dual_arm 没有腿，收录在双臂分类下。这里固定的 commit 比 robot_descriptions.py 记录的更新，后者还没有 mode 18 与 Dex1-1 两个文件。

variants.notes: Rev 1.0 hardware, mode_machine 5: hip pitch and roll geared 14.3 and 22.5, 4010 wrist motors. Upstream's current 29-DOF build, and what it ships in place of g1_29dof.
variants.notes_zh: Rev 1.0 硬件，mode_machine 5：髋 pitch、roll 减速比分别为 14.3 和 22.5，腕部为 4010 电机。上游当前的 29 自由度版本，用来取代 g1_29dof。

variants.notes: The rev 1.0 body with Unitree's two three-finger hands: seven joints per hand on top of the 29, 43 in all.
variants.notes_zh: Rev 1.0 本体加两只宇树三指手：在 29 个关节之外每只手 7 个，合计 43 个。

variants.notes: The rev 1.0 body with two Inspire DFQ hands: twelve joints per hand, 53 in all.
variants.notes_zh: Rev 1.0 本体加两只 Inspire DFQ 灵巧手：每只手 12 个关节，合计 53 个。

variants.notes: The same 53 joints as the DFQ build, with Inspire's FTP hands instead. Their fingertip force sensors are modelled as links, which is why this one carries 97 of them against the DFQ build's 63.
variants.notes_zh: 关节数与 DFQ 版本同为 53，换成 Inspire FTP 灵巧手。它的指尖力传感器也建成了连杆，因此连杆数为 97，而 DFQ 版本是 63。

variants.notes: Rev 1.0, mode_machine 6: the waist roll and pitch joints are fixed, so 27 of the 29 move.
variants.notes_zh: Rev 1.0，mode_machine 6：腰部 roll 与 pitch 固定，29 个关节里 27 个可动。

variants.notes: The locked-waist rev 1.0 with the two three-finger hands: 41 moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 锁腰的 rev 1.0 加两只三指手：41 个可动关节。

variants.notes: Rev 1.0, mode_machine 4: one waist joint and five per arm — no wrist pitch or yaw, and no wrist motors.
variants.notes_zh: Rev 1.0，mode_machine 4：腰部 1 个关节、单臂 5 个——没有腕部 pitch 与 yaw，也没有腕部电机。

variants.notes: mode_machine 11: hip pitch and roll both geared 22.5, 4010 wrist motors, waist free.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 11：髋 pitch 与 roll 减速比均为 22.5，腕部 4010 电机，腰部可动。

variants.notes: mode_machine 12: mode 11's hardware with the waist roll and pitch fixed, so 27 joints move.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 12：硬件与 mode 11 相同，腰部 roll 与 pitch 固定，27 个关节可动。

variants.notes: mode_machine 13: hip pitch geared 14.3 and roll 22.5, with the newer 5010 wrist motors.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 13：髋 pitch 减速比 14.3、roll 22.5，腕部换用较新的 5010 电机。

variants.notes: mode_machine 14: mode 13's hardware with the waist roll and pitch fixed, so 27 joints move.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 14：硬件与 mode 13 相同，腰部 roll 与 pitch 固定，27 个关节可动。

variants.notes: mode_machine 15: hip pitch and roll both geared 22.5, with the newer 5010 wrist motors.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 15：髋 pitch 与 roll 减速比均为 22.5，腕部为较新的 5010 电机。

variants.notes: The mode 15 body with a Dex1-1 two-finger gripper on each wrist: four prismatic finger joints on top of the 29.
variants.notes_zh: mode 15 本体加两只 Dex1-1 二指夹爪：在 29 个关节之外多出 4 个移动副手指关节。

variants.notes: mode_machine 16: mode 15's hardware with the waist roll and pitch fixed, so 27 joints move.
variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 16：硬件与 mode 15 相同，腰部 roll 与 pitch 固定，27 个关节可动。

variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 18：几何与 mode 15 完全一致，腰部更强——roll 与 pitch 标称 100 N·m、26.9 rad/s，而 mode 15 是 35 N·m、30 rad/s。

variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 10：23 自由度构型，髋部减速比 22.5——腰部 1 个关节、单臂 5 个，没有腕部电机。

variants.notes_zh: mode_machine 2，也是 robot_descriptions.py 固定的那个文件。髋 pitch、roll 减速比为 14.3 与 14.5；替代它的是 g1_29dof_rev_1_0。

robots.name: H2
robots.notes: Upstream also ships the same robot with Collada meshes and a closed-loop variant.
robots.notes_zh: 上游同一台机器人还提供 Collada 网格版本与闭链版本。

robots.name: H2 Plus
robots.notes: H2 with two dexterous hands, hence 75 moving joints against H2's 31.
robots.notes_zh: H2 加装两只灵巧手，因此有 75 个可动关节，而 H2 只有 31 个。

robots.name: R1
robots.notes: The ankles are parallel linkages. URDF cannot close a loop, so upstream ships the rods hanging free with constraint frames marking where they meet.
robots.notes_zh: 踝关节是并联机构。URDF 无法描述闭链，上游把连杆画成断开的，并用 constraint 坐标系标出本应连接的位置。

robots.name: R1 Air
robots.notes: A lighter R1: 20 moving joints instead of 26, with the same parallel ankles.
robots.notes_zh: R1 的轻量版本：20 个可动关节而非 26 个，踝部同样是并联机构。

robots.name: X2 Ultra
robots.notes: The v1.4.0 hardware — the revision whose nameplate ends in X2 Ultra -N. Upstream also ships v1.3.0 with the same 31 joints, and a 27-DOF fist variant whose arms stop at the wrist yaw.
robots.notes_zh: v1.4.0 硬件版本，即铭牌结尾是 X2 Ultra -N 的那一台。上游还提供关节数相同的 v1.3.0，以及手臂停在腕部 yaw 的 27 自由度假拳版本。

robots.name: A3 T3.0
robots.notes: The base A3 on T3.0 hardware. The repository carries an A3 T2.5 as well, but its URDF resolves every mesh through a robot_descriptions package the repository does not contain, so it cannot be loaded as published.
robots.notes_zh: T3.0 硬件的基础版 A3。同一仓库还有 A3 T2.5，但它的 URDF 把所有网格指向仓库里并不存在的 robot_descriptions 包，按原样无法加载。

robots.name: A3 Ultra T2.5
robots.notes: A3 Ultra on T2.5 hardware: the same 31 joints as the base A3, plus the head and torso RealSense cameras carried as extra fixed frames.
robots.notes_zh: T2.5 硬件的 A3 Ultra：关节与基础版 A3 一样是 31 个，另外把头部和躯干的 RealSense 相机建成了额外的固定坐标系。

robots.name: A3 Ultra T3.0
robots.notes: A3 Ultra with two dexterous hands: 63 moving joints against the 31 of the hand-less variants, sixteen per hand.
robots.notes_zh: 带两只灵巧手的 A3 Ultra：63 个可动关节，而不带手的版本只有 31 个，每只手十六个。

robots.name: Magicbot Gen1
robots.notes: 30 joints: six per leg, seven per arm, a two-axis waist and a two-axis neck. The hands are one rigid part here; upstream's MAGICBOT_with_hand.urdf splits each into a five-finger hand with 11 more joints.
robots.notes_zh: 30 个关节：单腿 6 个、单臂 7 个，外加两轴腰部与两轴颈部。这里的手掌是一整块，上游的 MAGICBOT_with_hand.urdf 把它拆成五指手，每只手多出 11 个关节。

robots.name: Magicbot Z1
robots.notes: 23 actuated joints: six per leg, five per arm and a waist yaw. The head and both palms hang off fixed joints, so the URDF moves one joint fewer than upstream's joint tree suggests.
robots.notes_zh: 23 个驱动关节：单腿 6 个、单臂 5 个，外加腰部 yaw。头部和两只手掌是固定关节，所以 URDF 里可动关节比上游 README 的关节树少一个。

robots.name: GR-2
robots.notes: Fourier's second-generation full-size humanoid in the Wiki-GRx-Models tree. The basic build has twenty-nine moving joints and dummy-hand stubs at both wrists; upstream also ships the same body with a six-DoF Fourier hand per side.
robots.notes_zh: 傅利叶第二代全尺寸人形机器人在 Wiki-GRx-Models 仓库里的描述。基础版有 29 个可动关节，两只手腕各接一个 dummy-hand 桩；上游还提供两侧各装六自由度傅利叶灵巧手的版本。

variants.notes_zh: 不带手腕 dummy-hand 连杆的基础本体。

variants.notes: The same twenty-nine body joints with the dummy-hand wrist stubs spelled out as separate links.
variants.notes_zh: 同样的 29 个本体关节，手腕 dummy-hand 桩被建成独立连杆。

robots.name: GR-3
robots.notes: Fourier's care-focused GR-3 in the Wiki-GRx-Models repository: thirty-one moving joints on a seventy-kilogram body in the basic build, with the same dummy-hand wrist option as GR-2.
robots.notes_zh: 傅利叶面向照护场景的 GR-3，收录在 Wiki-GRx-Models 仓库：基础版 31 个可动关节、整机约 70 kg，手腕同样提供 dummy-hand 版本。

variants.notes: The basic body without explicit dummy-hand links at the wrists.
variants.notes_zh: 不带手腕 dummy-hand 连杆的基础本体。

variants.notes: The same thirty-one body joints with explicit dummy-hand wrist links.
variants.notes_zh: 同样的 31 个本体关节，手腕 dummy-hand 建成独立连杆。

robots.name: Booster K1
robots.notes: 22 joints: two in the neck, four per arm and six per leg, with the ankles driven through a parallel four-bar. Upstream also ships a ZED-camera head and a locomotion variant that fixes everything above the waist.
robots.notes_zh: 22 个关节：颈部 2 个、单臂 4 个、单腿 6 个，踝部由四连杆并联驱动。上游还提供换装 ZED 相机头部的版本，以及把腰部以上全部固定的运动控制版本。

robots.name: Booster T1 (29 DoF)
robots.notes: The seven-DOF-arm T1: same head, waist and legs as the 23-DOF Booster T1 above, with three more joints in each arm. Only the 23-DOF layout has an MJCF upstream.
robots.notes_zh: 七自由度手臂版 T1：头部、腰部和双腿与上面 23 自由度的 Booster T1 相同，每条手臂多出 3 个关节。上游只为 23 自由度版本提供了 MJCF。

robots.name: Booster T2 (31 DoF)
robots.notes: 31 joints: two in the head, seven per arm, three in the waist and six per leg. The upstream folder also includes standard and parallel-ankle MJCF models.
robots.notes_zh: 31 个关节：头部 2 个、单臂 7 个、腰部 3 个、单腿 6 个。上游目录还提供标准版与并联踝版 MJCF 模型。

robots.name: Oli
robots.notes: LimX's 165 cm full-size humanoid, published as HU_D04 — 31 joints laid out exactly as the product page counts them: six per leg, three at the waist, seven per arm and two in the head. The two other versions are the same body with an end effector on each wrist: a four-jointed gripper, or a five-fingered hand of sixteen joints.
robots.notes_zh: 逐际动力 165 cm 全尺寸人形机器人，上游以 HU_D04 之名发布——31 个关节的分布与产品页给出的完全一致：单腿 6 个、腰部 3 个、单臂 7 个、头部 2 个。另外两个版本是同一本体在两只手腕上换装末端：4 关节夹爪，或 16 关节的五指灵巧手。

variants.name: HU_D04_01
variants.notes: The bare 31-joint body, wrists ending in a roll joint and no end effector. The only one of the three with a MuJoCo model beside it.
variants.notes_zh: 只有本体的 31 关节版本，手腕以一个 roll 关节收尾，没有末端执行器。三个版本里只有它旁边配了 MuJoCo 模型。

variants.name: HU_D04_01_with_gripper
variants.notes: The same body with a parallel gripper on each wrist: four joints per gripper on top of the 31, of which two mimic the other two, so 39 joints move on 35 motors.
variants.notes_zh: 同一本体，两只手腕各装一个平行夹爪：在 31 个关节之外每只夹爪 4 个，其中 2 个是另外 2 个的 mimic，因此 39 个关节由 35 个电机驱动。

variants.name: HU_D04_01_with_hand
variants.notes: The same body with a five-fingered hand on each wrist — four joints in the thumb and three in each other finger, sixteen per hand — which takes it to 63 joints and 78 links. Each finger's distal joint mimics the proximal one above it, at 1.155 on the four fingers and 1 on the thumb, so the 63 run on 53 motors.
variants.notes_zh: 同一本体，两只手腕各装一只五指灵巧手——拇指 4 个关节、其余每指 3 个，每只手 16 个——全身因此有 63 个关节、78 个连杆。每根手指的远端关节mimic 它上面的近端关节，四指的倍率是 1.155、拇指是 1，因此 63 个关节由 53 个电机驱动。

robots.name: HU_D03
robots.notes: The discontinued humanoid HU_D04 replaced, kept in the same repository for the machines still running it. Same 31 joints in the same places and 1.3 kg lighter in the URDF; the arm is where they differ — this one ends at a hand yaw joint rather than the wrist roll of HU_D04.
robots.notes_zh: 已停产的人形机器人，被 HU_D04 取代，上游仍把它留在同一个仓库里供还在使用的机器参考。31 个关节的位置与 HU_D04 完全相同，URDF 质量轻 1.3 kg；差别在手臂末端——它以一个 hand yaw 关节收尾，而 HU_D04 是 wrist roll。

robots.name: TRON 2 DASF
robots.notes: The whole humanoid: SF legs joined to the DACH arms and head through a transition link, 26 joints, 66.8 kg on TRON2A and 68.2 on TRON2B, with an IMU on each half of the body and the depth camera on the upper one. TRON2A's zero is the robot's factory-calibrated zero rather than the knees-forward walking stance; rotating each hip yaw joint by π is what gives that stance. TRON2B is defined the other way round — its zero is the knees-forward pose, and it is the hardware that needs the offset. Both builds mount the upper body's arms head-down, so at the URDF zero they point straight up; the card and the measured height put the two shoulder pitch joints at their lower limit instead, which is the arms-down pose.
robots.notes_zh: 完整的人形机器人：SF 的腿经一个转接连杆接到 DACH 的手臂与头部，26 个关节，TRON2A 66.8 kg、TRON2B 68.2 kg，上下半身各有一个 IMU，深度相机在上半身。TRON2A 的零位是机器出厂标定的零位，而不是膝盖朝前的行走姿态；把两个髋 yaw 关节各转 π 才是行走姿态。TRON2B 反过来——它的零位就是膝盖朝前的姿态，需要补偏置的是实机。两个版本的上半身手臂都是倒装的，所以 URDF 零位下手臂笔直朝上；卡片渲染与实测高度改把两个肩 pitch 关节放在各自的下限上，也就是手臂自然下垂的姿态。

variants.name: DASF_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The TRON2A humanoid. Upstream ships no robot.urdf for this one — its README names this file and the MuJoCo model beside it as the pair to load.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2A 的人形本体。上游没有为它提供 robot.urdf——README 指名要加载的就是这个文件和旁边的 MuJoCo 模型。

variants.name: DASF_TRON2A_zeromass_graser
variants.notes: The same 26 joints with the grippers' mass zeroed and an end-effector frame added to each wrist.
variants.notes_zh: 同样的 26 个关节，夹爪质量清零，两只手腕各加一个末端坐标系。

variants.name: DASF_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B humanoid, 68.2 kg, standing knees-forward at its zero.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2B 的人形本体，68.2 kg，零位就是膝盖朝前站立。

variants.name: DASF_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DASF_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DASF_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: T800
robots.notes: EngineAI's 173 cm full-size humanoid. The description publishes 25 joints — six per leg, one at the torso, five per arm and two in the head — against the 29 excluding hands that the product page counts. The four it leaves out are the wrists: this build ends each arm at an elbow yaw joint, where T800 Pro carries a wrist pitch and a wrist roll. Its meshes are textured Collada rather than the usual bare STL, so loading it also pulls a directory of PNG textures the mesh count does not include. Read from EngineAI's native SDK, which is where the description lives: the Isaac assets in engineai_rl_lab are USD converted from this URDF, and its own README says so.
robots.notes_zh: 众擎 173 cm 全尺寸人形机器人。描述文件里是 25 个关节——单腿 6 个、躯干 1 个、单臂 5 个、头部 2 个——而产品页给出的是 29 个（不含灵巧手）。少掉的 4 个是手腕：这个版本每条手臂到肘 yaw 为止，而 T800 Pro 还有腕 pitch 与腕 roll。它的网格是带贴图的 Collada 而不是常见的裸 STL，因此加载时还会一并取一整个目录的 PNG 贴图，这些不计入网格数。取自众擎的 native SDK——描述文件本来就在那里：engineai_rl_lab 里的 Isaac 资产是从这个 URDF 转出的 USD，它自己的 README 就是这么写的。

robots.name: T800 Pro
robots.notes: T800 with the arms finished: a two-axis wrist and a three-fingered hand on each side — thumb, index and middle, seven joints per hand — which takes it from 25 joints to 43 at the same 85 kg. One of the heaviest models in the gallery, and textured Collada like T800, with the same texture directory beside it. Read from EngineAI's native SDK, which is where the description lives: the Isaac assets in engineai_rl_lab are USD converted from this URDF, and its own README says so.
robots.notes_zh: 把手臂做完整的 T800：每侧多出两轴手腕和一只三指手——拇指、食指、中指，每只手 7 个关节——关节数从 25 增加到 43，整机质量仍是 85 kg。它是合集里最大的几个模型之一，网格与 T800 一样是带贴图的 Collada，旁边同样有一整个贴图目录。取自众擎的 native SDK——描述文件本来就在那里：engineai_rl_lab 里的 Isaac 资产是从这个 URDF 转出的 USD，它自己的 README 就是这么写的。

robots.name: PM01
robots.notes: EngineAI's 138 cm humanoid. The description publishes 24 joints — six per leg, one at the torso, five per arm and one in the head — on a 41 kg body, against the 23 the spec sheet counts by giving the neck none. Fixed frames hang off the feet, both elbow ends, and a camera on the head and another on the torso. Textured Collada like T800. Both URDFs still name package://resource/robot/pm01_edu/, the layout EngineAI's native SDK uses; this repository keeps each version in its own directory, so those paths are rewritten onto the tree that actually holds the files. The Edu build's torso Collada is 29 MB, past jsDelivr's 20 MB file limit, so the gallery loads the OBJ sitting next to it; the navigation build's torso is under the limit and keeps its Collada, and adds a fixed Livox frame on the torso. The repository publishes no licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 众擎 138 cm 人形机器人。描述文件里是 24 个关节——单腿 6 个、躯干 1 个、单臂 5 个、头部 1 个——整机 41 kg，而规格表按颈部 0 自由度计成 23 个。脚底、两只肘末端、头部相机和躯干相机各挂了一个固定坐标系。网格与 T800 一样是带贴图的 Collada。两份 URDF 仍写成 package://resource/robot/pm01_edu/，那是众擎 native SDK 的目录布局；这个仓库把每个版本放在自己的目录里，所以这些路径会被改写到文件实际所在的树上。Edu 版本的躯干 Collada 有 29 MB，超过 jsDelivr 单文件 20 MB 上限，因此合集改加载旁边的 OBJ；导航版的躯干未超限，保留 Collada，并在躯干上多了一个固定的 Livox 坐标系。仓库没有许可证文件。

variants.name: pm01_edu
variants.notes: The current educational description (v2): 24 joints, cameras on the head and torso. The torso visual is the OBJ, because the Collada next to it exceeds jsDelivr's 20 MB limit.
variants.notes_zh: 当前的教育版描述（v2）：24 个关节，头部和躯干各有相机。躯干外观改用 OBJ，因为旁边的 Collada 超过 jsDelivr 的 20 MB 上限。

variants.name: pm01_lidar
variants.notes: The navigation description (v1): the same 24 joints plus a fixed Livox frame on the torso, and a torso Collada small enough to load as-is.
variants.notes_zh: 导航版描述（v1）：同样 24 个关节，躯干上多一个固定的 Livox 坐标系，躯干 Collada 未超限，按原文件加载。

robots.name: Mini Hi
robots.notes: HighTorque's 25-joint humanoid: six per leg, one at the waist, five per arm and two in the head, on 18.3 kg. The URDF also declares a floating joint from a world link to the base, which is a simulator's free base rather than an actuator, so it is not counted here. The repository ships no licence file; its ROS manifests carry only the SolidWorks exporter's default BSD line.
robots.notes_zh: 高擎 25 关节人形机器人：单腿 6 个、腰部 1 个、单臂 5 个、头部 2 个，整机 18.3 kg。URDF 里另有一个从 world 连杆到基座的 floating 关节，那是仿真器的自由基座而不是执行器，因此不计入自由度。仓库没有许可证文件，ROS package.xml 里只有 SolidWorks 导出器默认写的那行 BSD。

robots.name: Mini Pi plus
robots.notes: Mini Pi with an upper body: the same twelve leg joints plus five per arm and two in the head, 24 in all on 11.0 kg. No MuJoCo model is offered for it — the XML beside the URDF is a 20-joint build of the same machine, which upstream's own changelog points out. Same licence position as the other two HighTorque entries.
robots.notes_zh: 加了上半身的 Mini Pi：同样的 12 个腿部关节，再加单臂 5 个、头部 2 个，合计 24 个，整机 11.0 kg。它没有配套的 MuJoCo 模型——URDF 旁边那个 XML 是同一台机器的 20 关节版本，上游的更新日志自己写明了这一点。许可证情况与另外两个高擎条目相同。

robots.name: PiPlus S

variants.notes: Twenty-three moving joints: six per leg, five per arm and one at the waist; the two head joints are fixed.
variants.notes_zh: 23 个可动关节：单腿 6 个、单臂 5 个、腰部 1 个；头部两个关节固定。

variants.notes: Twenty-two moving joints: six per leg, four per arm and two in the head; the waist is fixed.
variants.notes_zh: 22 个可动关节：单腿 6 个、单臂 4 个、头部 2 个；腰部固定。

variants.notes: The twenty-two-joint head-and-arm configuration with an additional moving waist yaw joint, for twenty-three in all.
variants.notes_zh: 在 22 关节的头部与手臂配置上增加可动腰部 yaw 关节，合计 23 个。

robots.notes: HighTorque's PiPlus S family, published on the repository's dedicated PiPlus_URDF branch. Its three descriptions share the same body but trade head, wrist and waist motion: one has ten arm joints plus waist yaw, while the other two have eight arm joints and a two-axis head, with or without waist yaw. The branch README licenses the package under BSD-3-Clause.
robots.notes_zh: 高擎 PiPlus S 系列，发布在仓库独立的 PiPlus_URDF 分支。三个描述共用同一机身，但头部、腕部和腰部自由度不同：一个版本为手臂 10 关节加腰部 yaw，另外两个为手臂 8 关节加两轴头部，并分为有、无腰部 yaw。该分支 README 声明使用 BSD-3-Clause 许可证。

robots.name: Digit
robots.notes: Agility's warehouse biped, as the DigitRobot.jl inverse-kinematics package ships it. Twenty-two joints, every one of them declared continuous: seven per leg — three at the hip, the knee, the shin-to-tarsus joint and two at the toe — and four per arm. On the real machine the tarsus and the toes are driven through four-bar rods; URDF cannot close a loop, so the rods are not in the file and those joints simply move on their own. The repository carries no licence file.
robots.notes_zh: Agility 的仓储双足机器人，取自 DigitRobot.jl 逆运动学包。22 个关节全部声明为 continuous：每条腿 7 个——髋部 3 个、膝 1 个、shin-to-tarsus 1 个、脚趾 2 个——每条手臂 4 个。真机的小腿与脚趾由四连杆驱动，而 URDF 无法闭环，所以文件里没有这些连杆，对应关节在这里是各自独立活动的。仓库没有许可证文件。

robots.name: Gundam RX-78
robots.notes: The test model the Gundam Global Challenge published for the 18-metre moving statue in Yokohama: 98 links and 77 revolute joints — 38 of them `mimic`s following another — down to a knuckle each per finger, at a URDF mass of 41 tonnes. Three orders of magnitude bigger than anything else in the gallery, and the one entry whose implausible-mass warning is simply the truth. Its licence is the association's own Terms of Use for the Gundam Research Open Simulator rather than an SPDX one — read it before using the model.
robots.notes_zh: GUNDAM GLOBAL CHALLENGE 为横滨 18 米可动实机公开的测试模型：98 个连杆、77 个 revolute 关节（其中 38 个是跟随其他关节的 `mimic`），连每根手指都各有一个指节，URDF 质量 41 吨。它比库里任何一台都大三个数量级，也是唯一一个「质量不合常理」的告警其实说的是实话的条目。许可证是该协会自己的《GUNDAM RESEARCH OPEN SIMULATOR 使用条款》，不是 SPDX 许可，使用前请先读它。

robots.name: X1
robots.notes: The description AgiBot trains its open-source X1 locomotion policy against: twelve revolute joints, six per leg, and everything above the waist — torso, arms, head — welded into fixed links. 58 links and 35 kg in all. The repository has no licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 智元用来训练开源 X1 运动策略的描述文件：12 个 revolute 关节，每条腿 6 个；腰部以上的躯干、手臂与头部全部固定。总共 58 个连杆、35 kg。仓库没有许可证文件。

robots.name: Walker S2
robots.notes: UBTECH's Walker S2 EDU exploration model and the official simulation model for the 2026 Global Humanoid Robot Competition. The repository publishes three URDF configurations of the same body: a pair of third-generation dexterous hands, parallel grippers, or simple fixed hands in a ROS 2 package, plus a separate USD model for Isaac Sim.
robots.notes_zh: 优必选 Walker S2 EDU 探索者，也是 2026 全球人形机器人挑战赛官方指定仿真模型。仓库为同一本体提供三种 URDF 配置：第三代灵巧手、平行夹爪，以及 ROS 2 功能包中的固定手版本；另附用于 Isaac Sim 的 USD 模型。

variants.name: Third-generation dexterous hands
variants.notes: The body with two third-generation five-finger hands: eleven revolute joints per hand on top of the body's twenty-eight, fifty actuated joints in all. The URDF also declares its world-to-base root as floating.
variants.notes_zh: 本体加两只第三代五指灵巧手：在本体 28 个运动关节之外，每只手有 11 个 revolute 关节，合计 50 个执行关节；URDF 另把 world 到 base 的根关节声明为 floating。

variants.name: Parallel grippers
variants.notes: The body with a parallel gripper on each wrist: twenty-eight revolute body joints and four prismatic gripper joints, thirty-two actuated joints in all. The URDF also declares its world-to-base root as floating.
variants.notes_zh: 本体的两只手腕各装一个平行夹爪：本体 28 个 revolute 关节加夹爪 4 个 prismatic 关节，合计 32 个执行关节；URDF 另把 world 到 base 的根关节声明为 floating。

variants.name: ROS 2 fixed hands
variants.notes: The ROS 2 package's thirty-revolute-joint body with simple hands fixed to the wrists.
variants.notes_zh: ROS 2 功能包里的 30 个 revolute 关节本体，手部固定在手腕上。

robots.name: OpenLoong
robots.notes: The open-source Qinglong humanoid from the OpenLoong retargeting project: thirty-one moving joints on a twenty-two-kilogram body in this URDF, with meshes referenced relative to the package directory rather than through package:// lines. The same folder also ships a MuJoCo model beside it.
robots.notes_zh: OpenLoong 重定向项目里的开源青龙人形机器人：这份 URDF 有 31 个可动关节、整机约 22 kg，网格用相对路径而不是 package:// 引用。同一目录下还附带 MuJoCo 模型。

robots.name: TienKung
robots.notes: X-Humanoid's open TienKung / Tiangong URDF collection. The version picker swaps between the Pro body, Tiangong 2.0 Pro with and without dexterous hands, Tiangong 3.0, Tianyi 2.0 and the Tiangong 2 Dex build. The Lite publish folder is not listed: its pelvis and waist meshes exceed jsDelivr's twenty-megabyte file limit.
robots.notes_zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心（X-Humanoid）公开的天工 URDF 合集。版本选择器可在 Pro 本体、带/不带灵巧手的天工 2.0 Pro、天工 3.0、天轶 2.0 与天工 2 Dex 之间切换。Lite 发布目录未收录：其骨盆与腰部网格超过 jsDelivr 单文件 20 MB 上限。

variants.name: TienKung Pro
variants.notes: The Pro humanoid body: fifty moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: Pro 人形本体：50 个可动关节。

variants.name: Tiangong 2.0 Pro
variants.notes: The Tiangong 2.0 Pro body without hands: thirty moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 不带灵巧手的天工 2.0 Pro 本体：30 个可动关节。

variants.name: Tiangong 2.0 Pro with hands
variants.notes: Tiangong 2.0 Pro with two dexterous hands: fifty-four moving joints in all.
variants.notes_zh: 带两只灵巧手的天工 2.0 Pro：合计 54 个可动关节。

variants.name: Tiangong 3.0
variants.notes: The Tiangong 3.0 body: twenty-five moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 天工 3.0 本体：25 个可动关节。

variants.name: Tianyi 2.0
variants.notes: The Tianyi 2.0 humanoid: twenty-one moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 天轶 2.0 人形机器人：21 个可动关节。

variants.name: Tiangong 2 Dex
variants.notes: The Tiangong 2 Dex build: thirty-one moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 天工 2 Dex 版本：31 个可动关节。

robots.name: Atom
robots.notes: Dobot's full-size Atom humanoid line. The P2 folder is the default card: twenty-nine moving joints on the upper-body build. P3 is a twelve-joint lower-body variant in its own mesh tree. The wheeled Atom-W builds live in a separate card because upstream keeps them in different packages.
robots.notes_zh: 越疆全尺寸 Atom 人形机器人系列。默认卡片取 P2 目录：上半身构型 29 个可动关节。P3 是 12 关节下半身变体，网格在独立目录。轮式 Atom-W 因上游包结构不同，收录在另一张卡片里。

variants.name: Atom P2
variants.notes: The P2 upper-body humanoid: twenty-nine moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: P2 上半身人形构型：29 个可动关节。

variants.name: Atom P3
variants.notes: The P3 lower-body build: twelve moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: P3 下半身构型：12 个可动关节。

robots.notes: Rhoban's kid-size football humanoid, four kilos over twenty joints. Written out of the CAD by onshape-to-robot as pure geometry: every link is a box or a cylinder, so the model has inertias and collision shapes but not one mesh file — the first such entry in the gallery.
robots.notes_zh: Rhoban 的儿童尺寸足球人形机器人，4 kg、20 个关节。它由 onshape-to-robot 从 CAD 直接导出为纯几何体：每个连杆都是长方体或圆柱体，因此有惯量、有碰撞体，却没有任何网格文件——这是库里第一个这样的条目。

robots.notes: LAAS's teaching humanoid: 29 joints on a 131 kg body, drawn entirely in boxes and cylinders. It exists to be a humanoid with nothing to download but the URDF — the model people reach for when what is being tested is the algorithm rather than the robot.
robots.notes_zh: LAAS 的教学用人形机器人：131 kg 的机身、29 个关节，全部由长方体和圆柱体画成。它存在的意义就是「除了 URDF 本身没有别的东西要下载的人形机器人」——测试算法而不是测试机器人时大家会拿它。

robots.name: Go2-W
robots.notes: The wheeled Go2: each foot is a continuous wheel joint on top of the usual three leg joints.
robots.notes_zh: 轮足版 Go2：常规三个腿部关节之外，每只脚是一个连续转动的轮关节。

robots.name: AS2
robots.notes: Present in unitree_ros but absent from its README. The 12 leg joints sit under a floating base joint, which is why the URDF counts 13 movable joints.
robots.notes_zh: unitree_ros 里有这个目录，但 README 没有列出。12 个腿部关节之上还有一个 floating 基座关节，所以 URDF 统计出 13 个可动关节。

robots.name: D1 MaxPro
robots.notes: Shipped inside AgiBot's D1 SDK repository rather than a description package of its own, which is also why it records no licence: the ROS manifest beside it still says TODO instead of naming one.
robots.notes_zh: 它随智元 D1 SDK 仓库发布，而不是独立的描述包，这也是它没有许可证的原因：旁边的 ROS package.xml 里仍写着 TODO，而不是具体的许可证。

robots.name: MagicDog
robots.notes: Three joints per leg plus a yawing head. The calf limits stop short of zero, so the knees stay bent whatever you do with the sliders.
robots.notes_zh: 每条腿 3 个关节，另有一个可左右转的头部。小腿关节的限位不包含 0，所以无论怎么拖滑块，膝盖都是弯的。

robots.name: MagicDog-W
robots.notes: The wheeled MagicDog: a continuous wheel joint below the usual three leg joints, 16 in all. The head is a fixed link here, unlike on the legged version.
robots.notes_zh: 轮足版 MagicDog：常规三个腿部关节之下再挂一个连续转动的轮关节，共 16 个。和足式版不同，这里的头部是固定连杆。

robots.name: Barkour v0
robots.notes: The dog DeepMind measured its Barkour agility benchmark on — three joints per leg on an 11.5 kg body. One of only two URDFs in MuJoCo Menagerie, which is otherwise MJCF throughout; its mesh paths still say `meshes/` while the files live in `assets/`, so the entry rewrites them.
robots.notes_zh: DeepMind 用来测量 Barkour 敏捷性基准的那条狗——11.5 kg 机身，每条腿 3 个关节。MuJoCo Menagerie 里只有两个 URDF，这是其中之一（其余全是 MJCF）；它的网格路径写的还是 `meshes/`，而文件实际在 `assets/`，所以条目里做了路径改写。

robots.name: Barkour vb
robots.notes: The second-generation Barkour: same twelve joints as v0 on a heavier 14.5 kg frame, plus a neck carrying a RealSense D435. Twenty-two of its thirty-four joints are fixed — the camera, its cover and the handle are all along for the ride.
robots.notes_zh: 第二代 Barkour：关节数与 v0 相同（12 个），机身重到 14.5 kg，并多了一段装着 RealSense D435 的颈部。34 个关节里有 22 个是固定的——相机、相机罩和提手都只是搭车。

robots.notes: The quadruped that ships with Bullet and has been the first legged robot in more RL papers than any other. Each leg is a five-bar linkage whose two halves meet at the toe — a loop URDF cannot declare, so the gallery closes it the way MJCF does, with a point weld the viewer solves the two knees against every time a motor moves. The knees are the other thing this description leaves out: both are revolute with an effort and a velocity but no travel, which most tools read as a joint pinned at zero. One mesh in the whole file — the hip motor, reused eight times; the chassis and the legs are boxes.
robots.notes_zh: 随 Bullet 一起分发的四足机器人，在强化学习论文里当「第一台腿式机器人」的次数大概比谁都多。每条腿是一组五连杆，两半在足端合到一起——URDF 声明不了这种闭环，本站于是照 MJCF 的做法补上一个点焊接约束，每次电机转动都用它反解两个膝关节。膝关节还有另一处缺省：两个 revolute 只写了力矩和速度，没写行程，多数工具会把它当成钉死在零位的关节。整份描述只有一个网格——髋部电机，被复用了 8 次；底盘和腿都是长方体。

robots.name: Mini Cheetah
robots.notes: MIT's 8 kg backflipping quadruped, three continuous joints per leg. The URDF was written by Erwin Coumans for PyBullet and its four meshes are derived from Unitree's Laikago CAD by permission; the licence file asks for a citation rather than granting an SPDX licence. Mesh paths are written relative to the repository root but the file sits in `urdf/`, so the entry rewrites them.
robots.notes_zh: MIT 那台会后空翻的 8 kg 四足机器人，每条腿 3 个 continuous 关节。URDF 由 Erwin Coumans 为 PyBullet 编写，四个网格经宇树授权自 Laikago 的 CAD 改出；许可证文件要求的是引用，而不是给出一个 SPDX 许可。网格路径是相对仓库根目录写的，而文件在 `urdf/` 里，所以条目里做了路径改写。

robots.notes: Visual-only description: no inertial parameters upstream.
robots.notes_zh: 仅含可视化几何，上游未提供惯性参数。

robots.name: UR3
robots.notes: The 3 kg-payload table-top arm, six revolute joints on 10.6 kg. Universal Robots publishes only xacro, which the gallery cannot expand; these are the plain URDFs example-robot-data generated from it, out of ros-industrial/universal_robot. The package carries no licence file of its own; its README declares BSD. The two versions differ in their limits alone — the default winds every joint but the elbow through ±2π, the joint-limited one stops all six at ±π.
robots.notes_zh: 负载 3 kg 的桌面机械臂，6 个 revolute 关节、10.6 kg。优傲官方只发布 xacro，本站无法展开；这里用的是 example-robot-data 从 ros-industrial/universal_robot 生成的纯 URDF。该目录没有自己的许可证文件，README 里声明为 BSD。两个版本只差在限位：默认版除肘部外每个关节都可以在 ±2π 内旋转，joint_limited 版把六个关节统统限制在 ±π。

robots.name: UR5
robots.notes: The middle of the three classic UR arms: 5 kg payload, 850 mm reach, six revolute joints on 21 kg, and the arm half the manipulation literature is written about. Same two versions as the UR3 — ±2π everywhere but the elbow, or all six stopped at ±π — and the same BSD its README declares in place of a licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 经典 UR 三兄弟里的中间一台：负载 5 kg、臂展 850 mm、6 个 revolute 关节、21 kg，也是操作类论文里出现最多的机械臂之一。版本与 UR3 相同：除肘部外都是 ±2π，或六个关节统统限制在 ±π；许可同样是 README 里声明的 BSD，没有单独的许可证文件。

robots.name: UR10
robots.notes: The largest of the three: 10 kg payload, 1300 mm reach, 32.7 kg of arm. Identical kinematics to the UR3 and UR5 scaled up, which makes the three of them worth reading side by side in the compare page. Same example-robot-data copy, same BSD its README declares in place of a licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 三台里最大的一台：负载 10 kg、臂展 1300 mm、自重 32.7 kg。运动学结构与 UR3、UR5 完全同构，只是尺寸放大——放进对比页并排看正合适。同样出自 example-robot-data，许可同样是 README 里声明的 BSD。

robots.name: Gen3 Lite
robots.notes: Kinova's 5.2 kg six-axis arm with its own two-finger gripper already on the flange — ten revolute joints in all, six in the arm and two per finger. The one plain URDF in ros2_kortex, whose other robots are xacro.
robots.notes_zh: Kinova 的 5.2 kg 六轴机械臂，法兰上已经装好自家的二指夹爪——共 10 个 revolute 关节：手臂 6 个，每根手指 2 个。它是 ros2_kortex 里唯一的纯 URDF，其余机型都是 xacro。

robots.name: LBR iiwa 7 R800
robots.notes: The 7 kg-payload sibling of the iiwa 14 already in the gallery: the same seven-axis redundant arm, a shorter reach and 27.1 kg against the iiwa 14's 30.6. Its mesh paths are written for a working directory one level up from the URDF, so the entry rewrites them.
robots.notes_zh: 库里已有的 iiwa 14 的 7 kg 负载版本：同样是七轴冗余结构，臂展更短，自重 27.1 kg，而 iiwa 14 是 30.6 kg。它的网格路径是按 URDF 上一级目录写的，所以条目里做了路径改写。

robots.name: Dex1-1
robots.notes: A parallel gripper: two prismatic jaws.
robots.notes_zh: 平行夹爪：两个移动关节驱动的夹指。

robots.name: Dex2-5
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one and both with a G1 wrist attached.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手，以及带 G1 手腕的两个版本。

robots.name: Dex3-1
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手。

robots.name: Dex5-1
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手。

robots.notes: Left hand; the same package also ships the right hand.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为左手，同一目录下还有右手模型。

robots.name: Revo2
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one. Eleven revolute joints, five of them driven by `mimic` off another joint, so six motors move the hand: one per finger plus the thumb's rotation.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手。11 个 revolute 关节中有 5 个通过 `mimic` 跟随其他关节，因此真正驱动的是 6 个电机：每指一个，加上拇指的旋转。

robots.name: Revo3
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one. Twenty-one independent revolute joints — four per finger plus five for the thumb — which is what makes it the wider hand next to the Revo2. The visual meshes are STL, the collision geometry a convex decomposition in OBJ. Upstream publishes these files without a licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手。21 个独立 revolute 关节——每指 4 个，拇指 5 个——这也是它比 Revo2 自由度高得多的原因。视觉网格为 STL，碰撞体是 OBJ 格式的凸分解。上游发布这些文件时没有附带许可证文件。

robots.name: LinkerHand L20
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream ships left and right for a dozen LinkerHand models in one repository. Twenty-one revolute joints, five of them `mimic` followers, leaving sixteen motors.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游在同一个仓库里提供十余款 LinkerHand 的左右手。21 个 revolute 关节中 5 个是 `mimic` 从动关节，实际驱动 16 个电机。

robots.name: ORCA Hand V1
robots.notes: An open-hardware tendon-driven hand: the seventeen joints are pulled by cables from motors in the forearm rather than actuators at the joints, which is why the fingers are as slim as they are. Upstream also ships a v2 export, `extended` versions carrying the camera mount and electronics, and both hands.
robots.notes_zh: 开源硬件的绳驱灵巧手：17 个关节由前臂电机通过绳索牵引，而不是在关节处放驱动器，手指才能做得这么细。上游还提供 v2 导出版本、带相机支架与电路板的 `extended` 版本，以及左右两只手。

robots.name: ROHand
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one. Six motors drive it, but the linkages that carry them are spelled out joint by joint — one revolute, nineteen continuous and five prismatic — so the viewer's sliders are the mechanism rather than the six commands you would send it.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手。实际由 6 个电机驱动，但 URDF 把传动连杆逐个关节写了出来——1 个 revolute、19 个 continuous、5 个 prismatic——所以查看器里的滑块对应的是机构本身，而不是你实际下发的 6 条指令。

robots.name: Sharpa Wave
robots.notes: The right hand on its own; upstream also ships the left one, a dual-hand model, and versions with a flange or a wrist. Twenty-two revolute joints, five of them in the thumb.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为单独的右手；上游还提供左手、双手模型，以及带法兰或带腕部的版本。22 个 revolute 关节，其中 5 个在拇指上。

robots.name: Wuji Hand
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one and a docking module. Twenty independent revolute joints, four to every finger including the thumb.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手和一个对接模块。20 个独立 revolute 关节，每指 4 个，拇指也是 4 个。

robots.name: DG-5F
robots.notes: The right hand; upstream also ships the left one and `short` versions of both. Twenty revolute joints, four per finger, and the only hand here whose visual meshes are Collada while its collision geometry is STL.
robots.notes_zh: 此处为右手；上游还提供左手以及两者的 `short` 版本。20 个 revolute 关节，每指 4 个；也是这里唯一一只视觉网格用 Collada、碰撞体用 STL 的手。

robots.name: DG-5F-S
robots.notes: The smaller, lighter DG-5F: the same twenty joints in a hand roughly half the mass. Upstream also ships the left one, a fifteen-DOF cut, and versions with a mount.
robots.notes_zh: DG-5F 的小型轻量版本：关节数同样是 20 个，整手质量约为前者的一半。上游还提供左手、15 自由度精简版，以及带安装座的版本。

robots.name: XHAND 1
robots.notes: Version 1.3 of the right hand. Robotera publishes no description repository, so this one is read from the All Hands Up archive rather than from a repository at a pinned commit.
robots.notes_zh: 右手 1.3 版本。Robotera 没有公开 description 仓库，所以这一条是从 All Hands Up 存档读取的，而不是某个仓库的固定 commit。

robots.name: HX5-D20
robots.notes: Revision 2 of the right hand. ROBOTIS publishes this hand as xacro, which this gallery cannot load, so the entry reads the expanded URDF from the All Hands Up archive instead of from a repository at a pinned commit.
robots.notes_zh: 右手 rev2。ROBOTIS 官方仓库只提供 xacro，本站无法直接加载，所以这一条读取的是 All Hands Up 存档里已展开的 URDF，而不是某个仓库的固定 commit。

robots.name: RH56F1
robots.notes: The right hand, six motors behind twelve joints. Inspire publishes this hand as xacro, so the entry reads the expanded URDF from the All Hands Up archive; the archive also flattened the mesh tree the URDF still refers to, which `assets.mesh_rewrite` puts back.
robots.notes_zh: 右手，12 个关节由 6 个电机驱动。Inspire 官方只提供 xacro，所以这一条读取 All Hands Up 存档里已展开的 URDF；存档还把 URDF 引用的网格目录压平了，由 `assets.mesh_rewrite` 还原。

robots.name: Omnihand Pro
robots.notes: The right hand: nineteen joints, seven of them `mimic` followers, so twelve motors. Agibot publishes no description repository, so this one is read from the All Hands Up archive — which keeps only the meshes it renders, so the thirteen collision hulls are absent and skipped. The five primitive collision shapes the URDF also carries are all the collision view has to show here.
robots.notes_zh: 右手：19 个关节中 7 个是 `mimic` 从动关节，实际 12 个电机。智元没有公开 description 仓库，所以这一条从 All Hands Up 存档读取；该存档只保留自己要渲染的网格，13 个碰撞包络因此缺失并被跳过。URDF 里另有 5 个原始碰撞形状，是这里碰撞体视图能显示的全部内容。

robots.name: DexHand
robots.notes: The right hand of the open-source DexHand, and one of the few in the gallery that brings its wrist with it — 24 revolute joints — four per finger, five in the thumb and three at the wrist, over 43 cm from the forearm stump to the middle fingertip. Upstream ships the left hand too.
robots.notes_zh: 开源 DexHand 的右手，也是库里少数把手腕一并带上的灵巧手——24 个 revolute 关节：四指每指 4 个、拇指 5 个、手腕 3 个，从前臂断面到中指指尖 43 cm。上游同时提供左手。

robots.name: Shadow Hand E3M5
robots.notes: Shadow Robot's anthropomorphic hand with four fingers, an opposable thumb and a two-axis wrist. The card opens the right motor hand; the version picker also exposes the left hand and the Plus forearm variants. These are the plain URDFs shipped beside sr_common's MuJoCo models, so they need no xacro expansion, and each version links its matching MJCF.
robots.notes_zh: Shadow Robot 的仿人灵巧手，包含四指、对掌拇指和两自由度手腕。卡片默认打开右手电机版，版本选择器还可切换左手及 Plus 前臂版本。这些是 sr_common 随 MuJoCo 模型一同发布的已展开 URDF，无需再运行 xacro；每个版本同时链接对应 MJCF。

robots.name: TRON 1
robots.notes: One biped sold with three interchangeable foot ends, which is why upstream ships it as ten descriptions rather than one: a point foot on six joints, and a sole foot or a wheel on eight, the extra pair per leg being the ankle or the wheel. Every file is called robot.urdf, so the version picker labels each by the directory it sits in. The legs are the same in all ten — 0.30 m from hip pitch to knee and 0.30 m from knee to the foot end — and what the four PF_P441 development units change is the body above them: their hip abduction axis hangs 0.087–0.099 m below the base origin where TRON 1's hangs 0.260 m.
robots.notes_zh: 同一台双足机器人配三种可换足端，所以上游把它发布成十个描述文件而不是一个：点足 6 个关节，足底或轮足 8 个，每条腿多出来的那一个是踝或轮。十个文件都叫 robot.urdf，因此版本选择器用它们所在的目录名来区分。十个版本的腿完全相同——髋 pitch 到膝 0.30 m、膝到足端 0.30 m——四个 PF_P441 开发机改的是腿以上的机身：它们的髋外展轴在基座原点下方 0.087–0.099 m，而 TRON 1 是 0.260 m。

variants.name: PF_TRON1A
variants.notes: Point foot: three joints per leg — hip abduction, hip pitch, knee — and nothing below the shank but a contact frame. 18.6 kg, and the simplest of the three ends to control.
variants.notes_zh: 点足：每条腿 3 个关节——髋外展、髋 pitch、膝——小腿以下只有一个接触坐标系。18.6 kg，三种足端里最好控制的一种。

variants.name: PF_TRON1B
variants.notes: The same 18.6 kg point-foot machine as PF_TRON1A, byte for byte apart from the mesh directory each file names: upstream keeps a copy per hardware batch.
variants.notes_zh: 与 PF_TRON1A 完全相同的 18.6 kg 点足机型，两个文件除了各自指向的网格目录之外逐字节一致：上游按硬件批次各留一份。

variants.name: SF_TRON1A
variants.notes: Sole foot: an ankle pitch joint carrying a flat foot, so four joints per leg and 20.8 kg. The ankle is the weakest joint on the machine — 20 N·m against the 80 N·m of the hip and knee.
variants.notes_zh: 足底：多出一个踝 pitch 关节托着平足板，每条腿 4 个关节，整机 20.8 kg。踝是全身最弱的关节——20 N·m，而髋与膝是 80 N·m。

variants.name: SF_TRON1B
variants.notes: The sole-foot machine again, identical to SF_TRON1A except for the mesh directory it reads from.
variants.notes_zh: 同样的足底机型，除了读取的网格目录之外与 SF_TRON1A 完全一致。

variants.name: WF_TRON1A
variants.notes: Wheel foot: a driven wheel where the ankle would be, declared with ±1e6 rad of travel and twice the speed limit of any other joint (40 rad/s against 15). 22.3 kg, the heaviest of the three ends.
variants.notes_zh: 轮足：踝的位置换成一个驱动轮，行程标称 ±1e6 rad，转速上限是其它关节的两倍（40 rad/s 对 15）。22.3 kg，三种足端里最重的一种。

variants.name: WF_TRON1B
variants.notes: The wheel-foot machine again, identical to WF_TRON1A except for the mesh directory it reads from.
variants.notes_zh: 同样的轮足机型，除了读取的网格目录之外与 WF_TRON1A 完全一致。

variants.name: PF_P441A
variants.notes: The first of the four P441 development units: the point-foot leg under a shorter body, 18.5 kg, and the only version of the ten whose joints are declared at 20 rad/s rather than 15.
variants.notes_zh: 四台 P441 开发机中的第一台：点足腿配更矮的机身，18.5 kg，也是十个版本里唯一把关节转速标成 20 rad/s（而不是 15）的一个。

variants.name: PF_P441B
variants.notes: P441B, 17.5 kg — the lightest of the ten. Its hips sit 0.091 m below the base origin, 8 mm higher than P441A's.
variants.notes_zh: P441B，17.5 kg——十个版本里最轻的一个。它的髋在基座原点下方 0.091 m，比 P441A 高 8 mm。

variants.name: PF_P441C
variants.notes: P441C, 18.8 kg, the heaviest P441 and the one that carries its hips highest, 0.087 m below the base origin. Its two hip abduction joints are also the only pair in the repository that are not mirror images: the left is 0.1095 m out from the centre line and the right 0.1005 m, where every other version has both at 0.105 m.
variants.notes_zh: P441C，18.8 kg，四台 P441 里最重的，髋的位置也最高，在基座原点下方 0.087 m。它的两个髋外展关节还是整个仓库里唯一不左右对称的一对：左侧离中线 0.1095 m，右侧 0.1005 m，而其它版本左右都是 0.105 m。

variants.name: PF_P441C2
variants.notes: P441C2, 18.4 kg: C's revision, with the two hip abduction joints put back on the same 0.105 m offset left and right.
variants.notes_zh: P441C2，18.4 kg：C 的修订版，把左右髋外展关节的偏置改回了一致的 0.105 m。

robots.name: TRON 2 WF
robots.notes: TRON 2's wheeled-leg form: five joints per leg — hip yaw, roll and pitch, knee, and a driven wheel where a foot would be. 34.9 kg on TRON2A and 35.6 on TRON2B. TRON2A's zero is the robot's factory-calibrated zero rather than the knees-forward walking stance; rotating each hip yaw joint by π is what gives that stance. TRON2B is defined the other way round — its zero is the knees-forward pose, and it is the hardware that needs the offset.
robots.notes_zh: TRON 2 的轮腿形态：每条腿 5 个关节——髋 yaw、roll、pitch、膝，以及本该是脚的位置上的一个驱动轮。TRON2A 34.9 kg，TRON2B 35.6 kg。TRON2A 的零位是机器出厂标定的零位，而不是膝盖朝前的行走姿态；把两个髋 yaw 关节各转 π 才是行走姿态。TRON2B 反过来——它的零位就是膝盖朝前的姿态，需要补偏置的是实机。

variants.name: WF_TRON2A
variants.notes: The wheeled biped as upstream's Gazebo and RViz launches load it.
variants.notes_zh: 上游的 Gazebo 与 RViz 启动文件加载的轮式双足本体。

variants.name: WF_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as WF_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 WF_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

variants.name: WF_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build of the same machine: 0.6 kg heavier, and drawn at the knees-forward pose rather than the factory zero.
variants.notes_zh: 同一台机器的 TRON2B 版本：重 0.6 kg，并且画的是膝盖朝前的姿态而不是出厂零位。

variants.name: WF_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as WF_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 WF_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: TRON 2 SF
robots.notes: TRON 2's sole form: the same hip and knee as WF with an ankle pitch joint and a flat foot in place of the wheel, so it stands still where the wheeled build has to balance. 34.8 kg on TRON2A, 35.7 on TRON2B. TRON2A's zero is the robot's factory-calibrated zero rather than the knees-forward walking stance; rotating each hip yaw joint by π is what gives that stance. TRON2B is defined the other way round — its zero is the knees-forward pose, and it is the hardware that needs the offset.
robots.notes_zh: TRON 2 的足底形态：髋与膝和 WF 相同，轮子换成一个踝 pitch 关节加平足板，因此它能站住，而轮式版本必须一直平衡。TRON2A 34.8 kg，TRON2B 35.7 kg。TRON2A 的零位是机器出厂标定的零位，而不是膝盖朝前的行走姿态；把两个髋 yaw 关节各转 π 才是行走姿态。TRON2B 反过来——它的零位就是膝盖朝前的姿态，需要补偏置的是实机。

variants.name: SF_TRON2A
variants.notes: The sole-foot biped at the factory zero — the pose in upstream's own SF_0.jpg.
variants.notes_zh: 出厂零位下的足底双足本体——也就是上游 SF_0.jpg 里的那个姿态。

variants.name: SF_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as SF_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 SF_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

variants.name: SF_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build, 0.9 kg heavier and already standing knees-forward.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2B 版本，重 0.9 kg，并且本来就是膝盖朝前站着的。

variants.name: SF_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as SF_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 SF_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: SA01
robots.notes: A pair of legs and nothing else: twelve joints, six per leg, on a 33 kg body — the walking platform EngineAI ships its Isaac Gym training environment with, under the internal name zqsa01. It carries no licence file of its own; the repository's setup.py declares BSD-3-Clause for the whole thing.
robots.notes_zh: 只有两条腿：12 个关节，每条腿 6 个，机身 33 kg——众擎在自家 Isaac Gym 训练环境里附带的行走平台，内部名字是 zqsa01。它没有自己的许可证文件；仓库的 setup.py 为整个仓库声明了 BSD-3-Clause。

robots.name: Mini Pi
robots.notes: The legs on their own: twelve joints on 7.1 kg, and the pair Mini Pi plus puts an upper body on — the same six joint names per leg, prefixed here with the wiring order rather than left and right, so the right leg is 01–06 and the left 07–12. Same licence position as the other two HighTorque entries: no licence file in the repository.
robots.notes_zh: 只有腿：12 个关节、7.1 kg，也就是 Mini Pi plus 在上面加装上半身的那一对腿——每条腿的六个关节名字相同，只是这里按接线顺序加了编号前缀而不是左右，所以右腿是 01–06、左腿是 07–12。许可证情况与另外两个高擎条目相同：仓库里没有许可证文件。

robots.notes: Benjamin Bokser's open-source biped: a body and two four-joint legs, 11 kg, with the segments named after a bird's — femur, tibiotarsus, tarsometatarsus, toe. Upstream named the joints themselves `1` to `8` and left it at that.
robots.notes_zh: Benjamin Bokser 的开源双足机器人：一个机身加两条 4 关节的腿，11 kg，各段按鸟腿命名——股骨、胫跗骨、跗跖骨、趾。上游给关节起的名字就是 `1` 到 `8`，再没有别的。

robots.name: BD-X
robots.notes: The free-walking droid Disney Research built for its parks, as a reinforcement-learning repository redrew it: sixteen joints on a 13.8 kg body — five per leg, four more through the neck and head, and one per antenna. The licence is the NVIDIA one the repository inherited from IsaacGymEnvs, not Disney's.
robots.notes_zh: 迪士尼研究院为乐园做的那台会自己走路的机器人，这里是一个强化学习仓库重新画出的版本：13.8 kg 机身上共 16 个关节——每条腿 5 个，颈部与头部 4 个，两根天线各 1 个。许可证是该仓库从 IsaacGymEnvs 继承来的 NVIDIA License，不是迪士尼的。

robots.name: Open Duck Mini
robots.notes: A community-built miniature of Disney's BD-X droid: sixteen joints on a 2.1 kg body — five per leg, four through the neck and head, and one per antenna — exported from Onshape with every mesh as an STL beside the URDF. The upstream URDF names meshes with an empty `package://` prefix; the build resolves them from the same directory as the file.
robots.notes_zh: 社区自制的迪士尼 BD-X 迷你版：2.1 kg 机身、16 个关节——每条腿 5 个，颈部与头部 4 个，两根天线各 1 个——从 Onshape 导出，所有网格都是与 URDF 同目录的 STL。上游 URDF 用空的 `package://` 前缀引用网格；构建时从该文件所在目录解析。

robots.name: Microduck
robots.notes: Pollen Robotics' tiny biped duck: about 25 cm and 800 g, fifteen servos on the hardware and fourteen actuated joints in the MuJoCo model — five per leg and four in the neck and head. The main microduck repository ships only a mesh-free kinematics file; the visual model with STL meshes lives here in microduck_rl, which is where the walking policies are trained.
robots.notes_zh: Pollen Robotics 的小型双足鸭子机器人：高约 25 cm、约 800 g，实机十五个舵机，MuJoCo 模型里十四个驱动关节——每条腿五个，颈与头四个。主仓库 microduck 只发布无网格的运动学文件；带 STL 网格的可视模型在训练策略用的 microduck_rl 仓库里。

robots.name: R1-A5
robots.notes: R1's upper body on its own: waist yaw, a two-axis head and two 5-DOF arms.
robots.notes_zh: R1 的上半身：腰部偏航、两自由度头部，以及两条 5 自由度手臂。

robots.name: R1-A7
robots.notes: The same upper body as R1-A5 with 7-DOF arms — the wrists gain pitch and yaw.
robots.notes_zh: 与 R1-A5 相同的上半身，换成 7 自由度手臂——手腕多了俯仰与偏航。

robots.name: G1 Dual Arm
robots.notes: mode_machine 9 of the G1 description: the torso, head and two seven-DOF arms with 4010 wrists, ending in fixed rubber hands. The waist joints are modelled but locked, so all 14 moving joints are in the arms. Filed here rather than with the G1's other versions because without the legs it is a different machine, as G1-D is.
robots.notes_zh: G1 描述目录里的 mode_machine 9：躯干、头部与两条七自由度手臂（腕部 4010 电机），末端是固定的橡胶手。腰部关节保留但已锁定，14 个可动关节全在手臂上。没有和 G1 的其他版本放在一起，是因为去掉双腿之后它已经是另一台机器了——G1-D 也是这样处理的。

robots.name: ALLEX
robots.notes: An upper body: two seven-DOF arms ending in two fifteen-DOF five-finger hands, on a two-DOF waist, with a two-DOF neck. Sixty revolute joints, of which twelve are `mimic` followers — ten finger couplings and two waist linkages — leaving 48 actuated. Filed with the dual arms rather than the humanoids because it has no legs. Upstream calls it a research simulation model of hardware still in development, and ships MJCF and USD beside the URDF.
robots.notes_zh: 一具上半身：两条七自由度手臂，末端是两只十五自由度的五指手，装在二自由度腰部上，另有二自由度颈部。60 个 revolute 关节中 12 个是 `mimic` 从动关节——10 个手指耦合、2 个腰部连杆——实际驱动 48 个。归入双臂而不是人形，因为它没有腿。上游说明这是仍在研发中的硬件的研究用仿真模型，除 URDF 外还提供 MJCF 与 USD。

robots.name: TRON 2 DA
robots.notes: TRON 2's upper body on its own: seven joints per arm — shoulder pitch, roll and yaw, elbow, and a three-axis wrist — ending in a fixed parallel gripper, with a chest D435 modelled as geometry. No legs, so it is filed with the dual arms. The arms are 8.5 kg each; the other 43 kg of the 60 the URDF adds up to is the rolling test stand the torso is bolted to, which upstream models along with it.
robots.notes_zh: TRON 2 的上半身单独成条：每条臂 7 个关节——肩 pitch、roll、yaw，肘，以及三轴腕——末端是固定的平行夹爪，胸前的 D435 只建了几何。没有腿，因此归在双臂分类下。两条手臂各 8.5 kg；URDF 合计 60 kg 里剩下的 43 kg 是躯干固定其上的那个带轮试验台架，上游把它一并建了模型。

variants.name: DA_TRON2A
variants.notes: The dual-arm torso, 59.7 kg. Its package:// lines name a tron2/ directory the repository has since renamed tron2a/, so the entry maps the two.
variants.notes_zh: 双臂躯干，59.7 kg。它的 package:// 路径写的是 tron2/ 目录，而仓库后来把它改名为 tron2a/，所以条目里做了映射。

variants.name: DA_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DA_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DA_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

variants.name: DA_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build of the same torso, 0.5 kg heavier.
variants.notes_zh: 同一躯干的 TRON2B 版本，重 0.5 kg。

variants.name: DA_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DA_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DA_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: TRON 2 DACH
robots.notes: DA with a two-axis head on top: the same seven-joint arms plus head yaw and pitch, sixteen joints in all. Upstream also ships a build with both grippers spelled out: nine joints per gripper, eight of them mimicking the one that drives the jaws through a crank, a bar and a nut. That takes the grasper versions to 36 moving joints on 20 motors — the sixteen of the body, plus a roll and a jaw drive per gripper.
robots.notes_zh: DA 加上一个两轴头部：同样的 7 关节手臂，再加头 yaw 与 pitch，合计 16 个关节。上游还提供了一个把两只夹爪展开建模的版本：每只夹爪 9 个关节，其中 8 个 mimic 那个经曲柄、连杆与丝母驱动钳口的关节。因此 grasper 版本有 36 个可动关节、20 个电机——本体的 16 个，加上每只夹爪的一个 roll 和一个开合驱动。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2A
variants.notes: The dual-arm torso with the head, 61.3 kg, grippers fixed shut.
variants.notes_zh: 带头部的双臂躯干，61.3 kg，夹爪固定不动。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2A_grasper
variants.notes: The same torso with both grippers spelled out: 45 links and 36 moving joints, 16 of them mimicking the two that drive the jaws.
variants.notes_zh: 同一躯干，两只夹爪都展开建模：45 个连杆、36 个可动关节，其中 16 个mimic 驱动钳口的那两个。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2A_zeromass_graser
variants.notes: The fixed-gripper build with the two gripper links' 0.53 kg zeroed and a fixed end-effector frame added to each wrist — for controllers that carry the payload in their own model rather than the URDF's.
variants.notes_zh: 固定夹爪版本，把两个夹爪连杆各 0.53 kg 的质量清零，并在两只手腕上各加一个固定的末端坐标系——给那些在自己模型里、而不是在 URDF 里记负载的控制器用。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DACH_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DACH_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build of the head-and-arms torso, 61.8 kg.
variants.notes_zh: 带头部双臂躯干的 TRON2B 版本，61.8 kg。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2B_grasper
variants.notes: TRON2B with both grippers spelled out, 36 moving joints on 20 motors.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2B，两只夹爪都展开建模，36 个可动关节、20 个电机。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2B_zeromass_graser
variants.notes: TRON2B's zero-mass gripper build, with the two end-effector frames.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2B 的夹爪零质量版本，带两个末端坐标系。

variants.name: DACH_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DACH_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DACH_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: G1-D
robots.notes: G1's upper body and two-finger grippers on a two-wheel base with a prismatic lifting column.
robots.notes_zh: G1 的上半身与两指夹爪装在两轮底盘上，中间是一根可升降的直线导轨。

robots.name: Atom-W
robots.notes: Dobot's wheeled Atom builds from the same repository as the biped Atom. P2 carries thirty-eight moving joints on a hundred-and-fifteen-kilogram body; P3 is a twenty-two-joint variant with its own mesh tree.
robots.notes_zh: 与双足 Atom 同仓库的越疆轮式构型。P2 有 38 个可动关节、整机约 115 kg；P3 是 22 关节变体，网格目录独立。

variants.name: Atom-W P2
variants.notes: The P2 wheeled build: thirty-eight moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 轮式 P2 构型：38 个可动关节。

variants.name: Atom-W P3
variants.notes: The P3 wheeled build: twenty-two moving joints.
variants.notes_zh: 轮式 P3 构型：22 个可动关节。

robots.name: Galbot One Golf
robots.notes: 27 driven joints — a five-joint folding leg, a two-axis head, two 7-DOF arms with a parallel gripper each and four omni wheels — inside 77 movable ones: each gripper carries five mimic joints and each wheel ten free rollers. The visual meshes are glTF, the only ones in the gallery.
robots.notes_zh: 27 个驱动关节：五关节折叠腿、两轴头部、两条 7 自由度手臂各带一只平行夹爪，以及四个全向轮；URDF 里共 77 个可动关节，因为每只夹爪有 5 个 mimic 关节、每个轮子有 10 个自由滚子。它的可视网格是 glTF 格式，全站仅此一家。

robots.name: Galbot S1
robots.notes: A warehouse picker: four steered and driven wheels, a prismatic torso lift, a two-axis head and two 7-DOF arms with three-jaw grippers. Four of the 31 movable joints mimic the gripper drives, leaving 27 driven.
robots.notes_zh: 仓储拣选机器人：四个可转向的驱动轮、一根直线升降立柱、两轴头部，以及两条带三指夹爪的 7 自由度手臂。31 个可动关节里有 4 个是夹爪的 mimic 关节，实际驱动 27 个。

robots.name: TRON 2 WFYG
robots.notes: The wheeled-leg base carrying the mast: a six-joint arm with a two-jaw gripper, a camera mount, a LiDAR and a pair of antennas, all on the transition bracket. Eighteen moving joints and 41.7 kg. The mast links are geometry only — upstream models the hardware it hangs there (a RoboSense Fairy96, an AgileX Piper X, a Huace M722 RTK and a Jetson Orin NX) as shapes, with no sensor plugins. TRON2A's zero is the robot's factory-calibrated zero rather than the knees-forward walking stance; rotating each hip yaw joint by π is what gives that stance. TRON2B is defined the other way round — its zero is the knees-forward pose, and it is the hardware that needs the offset.
robots.notes_zh: 轮腿底盘加上桅杆：一条 6 关节手臂配两指夹爪、一个相机支架、一个激光雷达和一对天线，全都装在转接件上。18 个可动关节，41.7 kg。桅杆上的连杆只有几何——上游把挂在那里的硬件（速腾 Fairy96、松灵 Piper X、华测 M722 RTK、Jetson Orin NX）建成形状，没有任何传感器插件。TRON2A 的零位是机器出厂标定的零位，而不是膝盖朝前的行走姿态；把两个髋 yaw 关节各转 π 才是行走姿态。TRON2B 反过来——它的零位就是膝盖朝前的姿态，需要补偏置的是实机。

variants.name: WFYG_TRON2A
variants.notes: The wheeled base with the full mast, 41.7 kg.
variants.notes_zh: 轮式底盘配完整桅杆，41.7 kg。

variants.name: WFYG_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as WFYG_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load. It also carries the gripper_pick frame the MuJoCo model marks the grasp point with.
variants.notes_zh: 与 WFYG_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。它还带上了 MuJoCo 模型里用来标抓取点的 gripper_pick 坐标系。

variants.name: WFYG_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build of the same rig, 42.3 kg.
variants.notes_zh: 同一套装配的 TRON2B 版本，42.3 kg。

variants.name: WFYG_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as WFYG_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 WFYG_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: TRON 2 SFYG
robots.notes: The sole-foot base under the same mast as WFYG — the same six-joint arm, gripper, LiDAR and antennas — so it can stand still while the arm works. Eighteen moving joints and 41.6 kg. TRON2A's zero is the robot's factory-calibrated zero rather than the knees-forward walking stance; rotating each hip yaw joint by π is what gives that stance. TRON2B is defined the other way round — its zero is the knees-forward pose, and it is the hardware that needs the offset.
robots.notes_zh: 足底底盘配与 WFYG 相同的桅杆——同样的 6 关节手臂、夹爪、激光雷达和天线——因此手臂作业时它能站住不动。18 个可动关节，41.6 kg。TRON2A 的零位是机器出厂标定的零位，而不是膝盖朝前的行走姿态；把两个髋 yaw 关节各转 π 才是行走姿态。TRON2B 反过来——它的零位就是膝盖朝前的姿态，需要补偏置的是实机。

variants.name: SFYG_TRON2A
variants.notes: The sole-foot base with the full mast, 41.6 kg.
variants.notes_zh: 足底底盘配完整桅杆，41.6 kg。

variants.name: SFYG_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as SFYG_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load. It also carries the gripper_pick frame the MuJoCo model marks the grasp point with.
variants.notes_zh: 与 SFYG_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。它还带上了 MuJoCo 模型里用来标抓取点的 gripper_pick 坐标系。

variants.name: SFYG_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B build of the same rig, 42.4 kg.
variants.notes_zh: 同一套装配的 TRON2B 版本，42.4 kg。

variants.name: SFYG_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as SFYG_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 SFYG_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: TRON 2 DASF2
robots.notes: The centaur: two pairs of SF legs, front and back, under the DACH arms and head — 36 joints, 105 kg and three IMUs, one per body segment. Filed as a mobile manipulator rather than a humanoid because what carries the arms here is a four-legged base. It is the one entry the gallery shows lying flat: all four legs and both arms are stretched out at the URDF zero, and standing it up means rotating each hip yaw joint by π — the offset upstream's README describes — which the two builds take with opposite signs, TRON2A's hip yaw running to -3.67 rad where TRON2B's runs to +4.63, so no single curated pose stands both of them up. Every other TRON 2 configuration stands at its own zero.
robots.notes_zh: 半人马构型：前后两对 SF 腿，上面是 DACH 的手臂与头部——36 个关节、105 kg、三个 IMU，每个身体段一个。归在移动操作而不是人形分类下，因为托着手臂的是一个四足底盘。它是合集里唯一一台摊平展示的机器：URDF 零位下四条腿和两条手臂都是伸直摊开的，要让它站起来得把每个髋 yaw 关节转 π——也就是上游 README 里写的那个偏置——而两个版本的限位方向相反，TRON2A 的髋 yaw 往 -3.67 rad 走，TRON2B 往 +4.63 rad 走，所以没有哪一个固定姿态能同时把两者立起来。TRON 2 的其它构型在各自零位下都是站着的。

variants.name: DASF2_TRON2A
variants.notes: The TRON2A centaur, 104.7 kg, lying flat at its factory zero. The only description in the repository that still carries Gazebo blocks — 48 of them, for the IMU and camera plugins. Its package:// lines name the pre-rename tron2/ directory, which the entry maps.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2A 的半人马，104.7 kg，出厂零位下四条腿是摊平的。它是仓库里唯一还带 Gazebo 段的描述——48 段，用于 IMU 与相机插件。它的 package:// 路径写的是改名前的 tron2/ 目录，条目里做了映射。

variants.name: DASF2_TRON2A_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DASF2_TRON2A, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DASF2_TRON2A 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

variants.name: DASF2_TRON2A_zeromass_graser
variants.notes: The Gazebo build with the grippers' mass zeroed and an end-effector frame per wrist.
variants.notes_zh: 带 Gazebo 段的版本，夹爪质量清零，每只手腕加一个末端坐标系。

variants.name: DASF2_TRON2B
variants.notes: The TRON2B centaur, 106.9 kg, laid out flat at its own zero like the TRON2A build.
variants.notes_zh: TRON2B 的半人马，106.9 kg，和 TRON2A 版本一样，在自己的零位下是摊平的。

variants.name: DASF2_TRON2B_rl
variants.notes: The same machine as DASF2_TRON2B, with the mesh paths written relative to the URDF instead of through the package and the material colours dropped — the file the RL stacks load.
variants.notes_zh: 与 DASF2_TRON2B 同一台机器，网格路径改成相对 URDF 而不是走 package，并去掉了材质颜色——RL 那套代码加载的就是它。

robots.name: R1
robots.notes: Galaxea's dual-arm mobile manipulator — not to be confused with Unitree's humanoid of the same name. Twenty-six moving joints on 102 kg: three steering and three drive wheels underneath, a four-joint torso that bends and turns the whole upper body, and two 6-DOF arms ending in parallel grippers. The repository has no licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 星海图的双臂移动操作机器人——与宇树同名的人形机器人不是一台。102 kg 上共 26 个可动关节：底盘 3 组转向轮加 3 个驱动轮，4 关节的腰身可以整体弯折与回转，两条 6 自由度手臂各带一个平行夹爪。仓库没有许可证文件。

robots.name: R1 Pro
robots.notes: The 2026 R1 Pro: the same three-wheel base and four-joint torso as the R1, with 7-DOF arms in place of the 6-DOF ones — 28 moving joints on a lighter 93 kg. Its gripper fingers are in the file but pinned, both prismatic joints declared with a zero-width range. The repository has no licence file.
robots.notes_zh: 2026 年款 R1 Pro：底盘与 4 关节腰身沿用 R1，手臂从 6 自由度增加到 7 自由度——93 kg 上共 28 个可动关节，比 R1 更轻。夹爪手指在文件里，但两个 prismatic 关节的上下限都是 0，动不了。仓库没有许可证文件。

robots.name: STAR1
robots.notes: RobotEra's full-size humanoid, which the file still calls by its internal name l3: 55 revolute joints on 64 kg — six per leg, seven per arm, twelve per hand, three at the waist and two in the neck — and the only description the repository ships. The hands are the unusual part of the count: 24 of the 55 joints are fingers, each finger a serial chain with the linkage pins fixed, which is what the file name's "fixedpin" means. The URDF's zero pose stands with the knees bent; the card renders the upright stance the README gives — hip pitch 30°, knee -60°, ankle pitch 30° — which puts the head at 1.71 m.
robots.notes_zh: 它人科技的全尺寸人形机器人，文件里仍沿用内部代号 l3：64 kg 上共 55 个转动关节——每条腿 6 个、每条手臂 7 个、每只手 12 个、腰部 3 个、颈部 2 个——也是这个仓库里唯一的描述文件。关节数的大头在手上：55 个里有 24 个是手指，每根手指都是一条串联链，连杆机构的销轴被固定住，这就是文件名里 fixedpin 的含义。URDF 零位下膝盖是弯的，卡片渲染的是 README 给出的直立姿态——髋 pitch 30°、膝 -60°、踝 pitch 30°——站直后头顶在 1.71 m。

robots.name: E1
robots.notes: Noetix's E1 as its Isaac Lab training repository carries it — the description ships inside the RL project rather than as a repository of its own: 24 revolute joints on 41.6 kg and 1.40 m, six per leg, five per arm and two at the waist. Head and torso are one mesh on the base link, so there is no neck joint, and each arm stops at its elbow yaw link — no wrist, no fingers. The three builds are the same body and the same 25 meshes; what differs is the collision geometry and which joints are left free. The Isaac Lab config in e1.py names a fourth file, e1_23dof.urdf, that the repository does not contain.
robots.notes_zh: 松延动力 E1，描述文件装在它的 Isaac Lab 训练仓库里，没有单独的模型仓库：41.6 kg、1.40 m，24 个转动关节，每条腿 6 个、每条手臂 5 个、腰部 2 个。头和躯干是根连杆上的同一个网格，所以没有颈关节；手臂到肘部 yaw 连杆为止——没有腕关节，也没有手指。三个版本是同一副身体、同样的 25 个网格，差别在碰撞体和放开哪些关节。e1.py 里的 Isaac Lab 配置还引用了第四个文件 e1_23dof.urdf，但仓库里并没有它。

variants.notes: The training build: all 24 joints free, and the collision meshes swapped for primitives — three boxes and twelve cylinders — with twelve links, the shoulders and forearms among them, left with no collision geometry at all.
variants.notes_zh: 训练用版本：24 个关节全部放开，碰撞网格换成基本体——3 个长方体加 12 个圆柱——另有 12 个连杆（包括肩部与前臂）干脆没有碰撞体。

variants.notes: The unedited export: the same 24 joints, with every one of the 25 links carrying its visual mesh again as its collision mesh. The primitives in the other two builds are commented out of this file rather than absent from it.
variants.notes_zh: 未经改动的导出版：同样 24 个关节，25 个连杆全都拿视觉网格当碰撞网格。另外两个版本里的基本体在这个文件里是被注释掉的，而不是没写。

variants.notes: The walking build: the waist and both arms welded, leaving the twelve leg joints. The arms are still drawn — links with fixed joints, not deleted geometry — and welded splayed rather than at the free build's zero, the shoulder roll offset changed from ±0.175 rad to ∓0.087, which is why this version measures 0.86 m across the arms where the other two measure 0.56 m.
variants.notes_zh: 行走用版本：腰部与两条手臂焊死，只留 12 个腿部关节。手臂仍然画着——是接了固定关节的连杆，不是被删掉的几何体——而且焊死的位置不是放开版本的零位：肩 roll 的偏置从 ±0.175 rad 改成了 ∓0.087，所以这一版两臂横向跨度 0.86 m，另外两版是 0.56 m。

robots.name: N2
robots.notes: The smaller sibling of the E1, shipped inside Noetix's Isaac Gym training repository: 18 revolute joints on 33.2 kg and 1.14 m. The legs have five joints each rather than six — one ankle joint, pitch only, so the foot cannot roll — and the arms four, ending in a hand link fixed to the elbow. There is no waist joint and no neck: head, torso and pelvis are all the base link.
robots.notes_zh: E1 的小一号兄弟，装在松延动力的 Isaac Gym 训练仓库里：33.2 kg、1.14 m，18 个转动关节。腿是每条 5 个而不是 6 个——踝只有一个 pitch 关节，脚掌不能侧翻——手臂每条 4 个，末端的手掌连杆固定在肘部。没有腰关节也没有颈关节：头、躯干和骨盆都属于根连杆。

variants.notes: All 18 joints free, every link with its own collision mesh.
variants.notes_zh: 18 个关节全部放开，每个连杆都有自己的碰撞网格。

variants.notes: The walking build: both arms welded at the shoulder, leaving the ten leg joints — and welded 0.3 rad further out in roll than the free build's zero, which spreads the arms from 0.47 m across to 0.67 m.
variants.notes_zh: 行走用版本：两条手臂在肩部焊死，只留 10 个腿部关节——焊死的肩 roll 比放开版本的零位再往外 0.3 rad，两臂横向跨度从 0.47 m 变成 0.67 m。

robots.name: DR02
robots.notes: DEEP Robotics' industrial humanoid, from the repository that also ships its quadrupeds. The version picker swaps between the Pro and Standard bodies. Pro publishes 31 revolute joints on 78 kg — three at the waist, seven per arm (the hands themselves are fixed links), two in the neck and six per leg — plus fixed frames for three RealSense cameras, a lidar and two IMUs. Standard drops the wrists, the neck and those sensor frames, leaving 21 joints on 68 kg: one waist yaw, four per arm and six per leg. Each version has an MJCF beside the URDF. The repository's high-res Collada files never covered this body — they were dropped before DR02 was added.
robots.notes_zh: 云深处的工业级人形机器人，和它的四足机型放在同一个仓库。版本选择器可在 Pro 与 Standard 之间切换。Pro 在 78 kg 上有 31 个转动关节——腰 3 个、每条手臂 7 个（手掌本身是固定连杆）、颈 2 个、每条腿 6 个——另外挂了三个 RealSense、一个激光雷达和两个 IMU 的固定坐标系。Standard 去掉了腕、颈和这些传感器坐标系，68 kg 上剩 21 个关节：腰 yaw 1 个、每条手臂 4 个、每条腿 6 个。每个版本旁边都有一份 MJCF。仓库里的高分辨率 Collada 从未覆盖这台机型——那些文件在加入 DR02 之前就已经从树上删掉了。

variants.name: DR02 Pro
variants.notes: The Pro body: 31 joints, wrists, a two-joint neck, and the camera, lidar and IMU frames.
variants.notes_zh: Pro 本体：31 个关节，带腕、两关节颈部，以及相机、激光雷达和 IMU 坐标系。

variants.name: DR02 Standard
variants.notes: The Standard body: 21 joints, arms ending at the elbow, no neck, only IMU frames on the head and base.
variants.notes_zh: Standard 本体：21 个关节，手臂到肘为止，没有颈部，头和基座上只留 IMU 坐标系。

robots.name: Lite3
robots.notes: Jueying Lite3, the educational quadruped: three joints per leg, 12 in all, on 12 kg. The version picker swaps the low-res STL meshes on the current tree for the high-res Collada Git LFS held before those files were dropped. Four visual meshes cover the whole body — hip, thigh, shank and torso — with the other legs mirrored by scale. The knee limits start at 0.52 rad, so the shanks stay bent whatever you do with the sliders.
robots.notes_zh: 绝影 Lite3，面向教学的四足：每条腿 3 个关节，共 12 个，整机 12 kg。版本选择器可在当前树的低分辨率 STL 与删库前 Git LFS 里的高分辨率 Collada 之间切换。全身外观只有髋、大腿、小腿和躯干四份网格，另外三条腿靠缩放镜像。膝关节下限是 0.52 rad，所以无论怎么拖滑块，小腿都是弯的。

variants.name: low-res
variants.notes: The meshes the repository keeps: four STL files, a few megabytes. Collision is primitive boxes and cylinders. An MJCF sits beside the URDF.
variants.notes_zh: 仓库里现在还留着的网格：四份 STL，一共几兆。碰撞是原始的盒子和圆柱。URDF 旁边有一份 MJCF。

variants.name: high-res
variants.notes: The Collada meshes Git LFS held until they were deleted from the tree. Each file is loaded from GitHub's LFS media host — jsDelivr and GitHub raw only serve the pointer. Collision stays primitive. No MJCF at this revision.
variants.notes_zh: 删库前 Git LFS 里的 Collada 网格。每个文件从 GitHub 的 LFS 媒体地址加载——jsDelivr 和 GitHub raw 只返回指针文件。碰撞仍然是原始几何。这个版本没有 MJCF。

robots.name: X30
robots.notes: The industrial quadruped: the same 12-joint layout as Lite3, 56 kg in this description, plus four fixed lidar frames — front and rear, each with an upper and a lower site. Knee limits start at 0.35 rad. The version picker swaps the current low-res STL for the high-res Collada Git LFS held before those files were dropped; that older URDF does not yet have the lidar frames.
robots.notes_zh: 工业级四足：关节布局与 Lite3 一样是 12 个，这份描述里整机 56 kg，另外挂了四个固定的激光雷达坐标系——前后各上下一组。膝关节下限是 0.35 rad。版本选择器可在当前的低分辨率 STL 与删库前 Git LFS 里的高分辨率 Collada 之间切换；旧版 URDF 还没有这些激光雷达坐标系。

variants.name: low-res
variants.notes: The meshes the repository keeps, plus the four lidar frames. An MJCF sits beside the URDF.
variants.notes_zh: 仓库里现在还留着的网格，以及四个激光雷达坐标系。URDF 旁边有一份 MJCF。

variants.name: high-res
variants.notes: The Collada meshes Git LFS held until they were deleted from the tree, loaded from GitHub's LFS media host. This snapshot has no lidar frames and no MJCF. The shank mesh alone is over 40 MB.
variants.notes_zh: 删库前 Git LFS 里的 Collada 网格，从 GitHub 的 LFS 媒体地址加载。这个快照没有激光雷达坐标系，也没有 MJCF。光小腿网格就超过 40 MB。

robots.name: Lynx M20
robots.notes: Lynx M20, the wheel-legged industrial machine: three joints per leg plus a continuous wheel at each foot, 16 in all, 34 kg. Fixed frames hang off the base for front and rear cameras and lidars. The version picker swaps the current low-res STL for the high-res Collada Git LFS held before those files were dropped; that older URDF does not yet have the camera and lidar frames.
robots.notes_zh: Lynx M20，轮足工业机：每条腿 3 个关节，脚下再加一个连续转动的轮，共 16 个，整机 34 kg。基座上挂了前后相机和激光雷达的固定坐标系。版本选择器可在当前的低分辨率 STL 与删库前 Git LFS 里的高分辨率 Collada 之间切换；旧版 URDF 还没有这些相机和激光雷达坐标系。

variants.name: low-res
variants.notes: The meshes the repository keeps, plus the camera and lidar frames. An MJCF sits beside the URDF.
variants.notes_zh: 仓库里现在还留着的网格，以及相机和激光雷达坐标系。URDF 旁边有一份 MJCF。

variants.name: high-res
variants.notes: The Collada meshes Git LFS held until they were deleted from the tree, loaded from GitHub's LFS media host. This snapshot has no camera or lidar frames and no MJCF.
variants.notes_zh: 删库前 Git LFS 里的 Collada 网格，从 GitHub 的 LFS 媒体地址加载。这个快照没有相机或激光雷达坐标系，也没有 MJCF。

robots.name: Lynx M20S
robots.notes: The higher-torque Lynx M20S: the same 16-joint wheel-legged layout and 34 kg body as M20, with actuator effort raised from 76.4 N·m to 140 N·m on the legs and from 21.6 N·m to 28.5 N·m on the wheels. Unlike M20, this description has no high-res URDF in the repository.
robots.notes_zh: 力矩更大的 Lynx M20S：轮足布局和 34 kg 本体与 M20 相同，共 16 个关节，腿部力矩从 76.4 N·m 提到 140 N·m，轮从 21.6 N·m 提到 28.5 N·m。和 M20 不同，仓库里没有这台的高分辨率 URDF。

robots.name: Lynx M20 Piper
robots.notes: Lynx M20 with an AgileX Piper arm bolted on: the 16 wheel-legged joints plus a 6-DOF arm and two prismatic gripper fingers, 24 moving joints on 39 kg. The composite has no high-res URDF in the repository.
robots.notes_zh: Lynx M20 上加了一条 AgileX Piper 机械臂：16 个轮足关节之外再加 6 自由度手臂和两个移动夹爪手指，39 kg 上共 24 个可动关节。这份组合描述在仓库里没有高分辨率 URDF。
